caption: The drawing depicts a red and orange metal teapot with a curved black handle and a spout extending to the left. The teapot features golden-yellow decorative patterns and a central oval illustration on its lower half. The illustration within the oval shows a landscape with a tan house with a green roof, a smaller adjacent outbuilding, some trees, shrubs, and brownish foliage or fields in the foreground. The overall background is light beige, and the signature "JOHN HALL" appears in capital letters below the teapot on the right side. The shading and highlights on the teapot give it a metallic, reflective appearance.
title: Toleware Teapot
